revision.description: The exact revision denied. A denial is void for any other revision.

denier.description: Role and instance, so independence on re-review can be evaluated.

author_within_authority.description: Whether the denied artifact's author is inside the issuer's authority. False for an objection against a decision held by a human gate authority, which is advisory: it voids nothing, consumes no amend budget, and carries no disposition.

disposition.description: What happens to the work next. Absent when author_within_authority is false.

findings.description: Entries conform to finding.schema.json. A denial citing no finding is an opinion.

input_revisions.description: Revisions this task's inputs were bound to at dispatch. A live task holding a superseded input revision is void.

reentry_step.description: The earliest affected step, not the step that produced the denied artifact.

invalidates.description: Completed steps or outputs voided by this denial. May be empty, but must be stated; silence is not the same as nothing.

amend_attempt.description: Which attempt of the amend budget this denial consumes.

lift_condition.description: What must be true for this denial to be satisfied, in terms the re-reviewer can observe.
